modules.name: @nit/core
modules.description: The shipped tree: the deterministic CLI (supervisor, resolvers, schemas) and the agent-facing definitions that drive it (step skills, command skills, agent personas). One module because they change together — a command and the skill that calls it must ship in one PR or the tree is inconsistent. ADR-0006's layering still holds inside it: skills invoke the CLI, the CLI never reads a skill.

modules.name: @nit/workspace
modules.description: Project business state — PRD, phases, tasks, decisions, retrospectives. Consumed by the shipped tree; depends on nothing (ADR-0006).
